newsitem.title: USA: Gundle/SLT to buy back 2.1 million shrs.
newsitem.headline: Gundle/SLT to buy back 2.1 million shrs.

text.p: Gundle/SLT Environmental Inc said Monday it had agreed to buy back about 2.1 million of its common shares from Odyssey Partners L.P. and a charity to which Odyssey transferred certain shares.
At $7 per share, the total cost will be $14.5 million. Closing is expected to take place on Jan 23. The shares represent 11.6 percent of GSE's total common shares outstanding as of Dec.
GSE will have about 15.8 million common shares issued and outstanding after this transaction.
"In light of our goal of putting our cash to good use, the repurchase is good for the company and its shareholders," said Bill Reid, GSE president and chief financial officer.
"In addition to being a good investment, the repurchase has an immediate positive impact on shareholder value.
Reid also said because the shares constituted a large private block, the purchase did not reduce the public float.
The company's shares closed down 1/8 at 7-7/8 on Monday.
